whatIs: Framer is a visual website builder with an AI agent that creates layouts, sections and components on an editable canvas from a description. It includes hosting, a CMS, analytics, A/B testing, localization and a marketplace of templates, components and plugins.

It's a good fit for landing pages and marketing or content sites that you want to design and publish in the same place, without setting up infrastructure. MCP-compatible agents, such as Claude or Cursor, can also edit the site.
uses: Launch a product landing page and publish it without configuring hosting.
Build a blog or a documentation page with CMS collections.
Start from a marketplace template and adapt it with the design agent.
caveats: The site is published on Framer's hosting, so you depend on the platform to keep it online.
The free plan uses a Framer domain; for a custom domain you need a paid plan.
The agent's actions consume AI credits, with a limited monthly quota.
pricingNote: Free plan with 500 AI credits per month and 1 GB of bandwidth; the Basic plan starts at $10 per month.
idealFor: Landing pages and content sites that are designed and published in one place.
